offer.text: I've a terrible sweet tooth today, my heart. Would you bring me half a dozen cookies? I'll share — maybe.

accept.text: You spoil me. I'll put the kettle on.

decline.text: Hmph. I'll dream of cookies, then.

ready.text: Six whole cookies! However did you know?

complete.text: Mm. Saved you the last one — see how good I am to you?
